answer: In a market where AI agents book river transport for jade, each voting identity must lock 100 tokens in a vault for 30 days before it can vote on service rules. Voting power is capped at one vote per deposit, and the same tokens cannot back two identities at once. Creating 1,000 fake voters therefore requires locking 100,000 tokens for a month, tying up capital and sacrificing its use elsewhere; generating new names adds no free votes.
